title: Factor Forge
summary: Store categories as factors, set the level order, and count them with table().
hints: `factor(condition)` makes a factor; its levels start in alphabetical order.
Set the order yourself with `levels =`: `factor(condition, levels = c("control", "waitlist", "treatment"))`.
`nlevels(condition_f)` counts the categories and `table(condition_f)` counts each one.
